Hindu festivals and observances scheduled for July 2026

Several Hindu festivals and observances are scheduled for July 2026, including Yogini Ekadashi, Deva-shayani Ekadashi, Masik Shivratri, Masik Janmashtami, and Kalashtami. Yogini Ekadashi is noted for its potential to absolve sins and is observed on July 10, 2026. Deva-shayani Ekadashi, marking the beginning of Chaturmas, signifies Lord Vishnu's entry into yogic slumber for four months, during which Lord Shiva is believed to oversee creation. Masik Shivratri and Masik Janmashtami also have specific auspicious timings for worship. Kalashtami observances are also detailed with dates and rituals.
